scientific_use: Run-9 campaign definition for a literature-anchored five-giant-planet resonant-chain instability and outer-disk transport ensemble. Execution and convergence are required before any delivery-probability claim.

literature_basis.resonant_chain: Nesvorny and Morbidelli (2012), AJ 144, 117; five-planet cases and a roughly 20 Earth-mass transplanetary disk
literature_basis.trigger_context: Liu, Raymond and Jacobson (2022), Nature 604, 643-646; instability during inside-out gas-disk dispersal
literature_basis.implementation_boundary: This REBOUND configuration represents the gas-free, planetesimal-backreaction branch. It does not implement the hydrodynamic rebound torque of Liu et al.
